entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: A lot of people are gathered here...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Our calling card has had a tremendous[n]effect.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm real proud of that one!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All they're doin' is makin' noise though...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Seriously. They should just go home and[n]sleep...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even after what happened, not many[n]people want to see Shido have a change[n]of heart...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What we're about to do is just... right?
It is.
Yes, they'll see soon.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's right.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Have we ever acted outside of the scope[n]of justice?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There you have it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You have a point.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, look over there.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: To think he'd actually go after Masayoshi[n]Shido... Youth is incredible.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: This has me excited as well. *snicker*[n]That boy really keeps the news rolling in.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She doesn't notice we're here... right?[n]That keen journalist nose is a force to[n]be reckoned with.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa! Why's Mishima here!? Man, that[n]kid's impressive...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are just.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I guarantee it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Heh... Now that's what I like to hear.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There may not be many of them, but we[n]have to cherish our fans.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's go change Shido's heart!
